dependency_historical_identity: not pinned by original wrapper; current recovered snapshot only
classification: evaluation correction; no runtime rollout or authorization
original_verdict_reproduction: mutation proposal escaped the one-file scope
native_and_independent_verifiers: separate explicit per-run executors; native remains the default
receipt_path_resolution: uses recorded native execution cwd; caller must supply it explicitly
patch_application: git apply --unidiff-zero; place patched qualify.py beside wrapper as qualify-base.py, with registered path helper
dependency_freeze: wrapper hashes and executes the same retained byte strings; loads the verified helper explicitly
native_target_scope: generated native callback resolves against ctx.cwd and real filesystem parent; exact one-file target; symlinks rejected; native approvals unchanged
caller_validation: public resolver and direct exact-path helper accepted; independent behavioral oracle remains required; copied reads/hashes and dynamic calls rejected
handoff_template_difference: registered wrapper locates frozen source relative to existing WORK; tested handoff has the equivalent absolute path; both have independent hashes
